system_note: Billed line: revenue code 0192 (Rehabilitation Therapy), 5 days billed for 2026-08-05 -> 2026-08-11. Clinical documentation: daily therapy session records show consistent, high-volume multidisciplinary therapy each day of the billed range (example: 2026-08-05 Physical Therapy 90 minutes) which, when combined with Occupational Therapy (60 min) and Speech-Language Pathology (45 min), yields 195 total therapy minutes/day on the dates reviewed. The dataset did not contain a payer-specific Aetna Medicare Advantage per-diem rule; the available Level of Care reference guide identifies 0192 as the rehabilitation therapy per-diem and notes that MDS/care plan support is supplemental (Policy ref). The facility's daily notes did not include any per-diem-level exception statements for any date in the billed range (the per-diem-level extraction returned null statements), which the reference guidance and retrieval tool note commonly occurs when the billed level is being met rather than when it is lacking. Taken together, the contemporaneous therapy minutes (consistent across every date 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11) and absence of any facility-level exception statements support the billed 0192 per-diem for the full date range. Citations: Policy reference (revenue code definitions) and the facility's session-level documentation and per-diem-level-note extraction are listed in evidence_cited below. Reviewed revenue line: billed revenue code 0191 for date range 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11. Payer-specific per-diem guideline for Kaiser Permanente Medicare Advantage was not found in the dataset; fallback to the payer-agnostic Level of Care reference guide used to interpret per-diem codes (see citation below). The reference guide identifies 0191 as a standard SNF per-diem level ("0191 (skilled nursing)") and defines the role of the MDS/care plan in supporting billed level of care (Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, position 8 and 9). Daily clinical documentation shows consistent, discipline-specific therapy minutes on every date in the billed range: for example, Physical Therapy 90 minutes on 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-11 (rows quoted below), plus Occupational Therapy 60 minutes and Speech-Language Pathology 45 minutes each of those dates (similar rows exist for all dates 08/05-08/11). The get_daily_services result notes these are the billed minutes per session (so the raw minutes are present in the medical record), and the per-diem-level extraction (get_per_diem_level_notes) contains null level-determination_statement entries for every date; the result's explanatory note states that a null statement commonly means the billed level's own threshold was met and the facility had no exception to document. Taken together - consistent therapy minutes each day across PT/OT/SLP (totaling 195 minutes/day) plus the facility's lack of per-diem exception statements - the medical record supports the billed per-diem level (0191) for the full billed date range 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-11. No downcoding, narrowing of date range, or units adjustment is required on this revenue line. Citations: Policy document identifying revenue codes (Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, position 8); extracted daily therapy session rows for dates within 08/05-08/11 showing minutes (see quoted rows below); get_per_diem_level_notes explanatory note indicating null level_determination_statement commonly means thresholds were met (see quoted note).

evidence_cited.citation: Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, position 8
evidence_cited.excerpt: Revenue codes 0191-0194: Standard billing codes for the four SNF per-diem levels of care referenced in these guidelines: 0191 (skilled nursing), 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), 0193 (sub-acute), 0194 (weanable ventilator management).

These are the billed minutes per session - they don't by themselves say which per-diem level a date supports. Call get_per_diem_level_notes for this claim before concluding a date's documentation is insufficient: the facility's own daily note frequently states the per-date determination outright, and that tool extracts it directly rather than requiring you to guess a search keyword.

level_determination_statement is null on a date when the daily note doesn't state an explicit per-diem-level exception for it - that does NOT by itself mean the day is unsupported; it commonly means the billed level's own minute threshold was met that day, so the facility had no exception to document. A non-null statement is the facility's own basis for downcoding that specific date.
